title: BKMA win 2024 Championship title
description: FINALBKMA - Mad Foxes 112-91 BKMA outrebounded Mad Foxes 50-30 including a 36-20 advantage in defensive rebounds. BKMA looked well-organized offensively handing out 25 assists. The former international Albert Tatevosyan (196-1993) stepped up and scored 36 points (!!!), 5 rebounds and 8 assists for the winners and the former international center Yura Melikyan (200-2005) chipped in 13 points and 20 rebounds. At the losing side the former international forward Artem Tavakalyan (198-1995, college: Delaware St.) responded with 28 points, 8 rebounds and 7 assists and Lebanese Varant Keledjian (190-1996) scored 16 points and 5 rebounds. Five BKMA and four Mad Foxes players scored in double figures. Mad Foxes' coach gave up on the game allowing to play ten players seeing no chance for a win.
